name: bot-fleet-monitor
description: Read-only, push-only status dashboard for Avi's Grok Bots (work + Leaf accounts).

scripts.build: npm run build:client && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
